history.alt_text: A modular mechanical shipping block interlocked with a sliding gauge on a steel rail, resting on a concrete surface.
history.caption: The shift from a fixed logistics base rate to a weekly floating fuel surcharge transfers pricing risk directly to shippers.
history.title: USPS Floating Fuel Charge Mechanism

style_when: the news is structural and abstract — a stack reordered, a layer added, a flow rerouted — and there is no literal object that carries it, so the idea is stated as a small physical assembly of recognisable parts rather than as bare shapes
prompt: Minimalist studio composition of a modular mechanical assembly on a weathered concrete warehouse floor. A matte clay shipping block interlocking with an adjustable mechanical dial sliding along a brushed steel rail. Extreme asymmetric composition, off-centre on the right thirds, generous negative space. One directional key light from the left throwing a long, hard cast shadow. Matte surfaces, visible moulding seams, and deep contact shadows. Slate grey, safety yellow, and weathered orange palette.
negative_prompt: garbled text, random lettering, numbers, UI, watermarks, embossed text, printed words, typography
rationale: A matte 3D render perfectly captures the structural shift from a fixed operational cost to a sliding, floating mechanism without relying on literal or generic stock photos of delivery vans.
subject: a modular mechanical assembly of a shipping block and a sliding gauge on a rail
core_thesis: USPS is transferring pricing risk to shippers by replacing a fixed 8% base postage charge with a weekly floating fuel surcharge.
core_conflict: Predictable, fixed budget numbers versus a volatile, floating weekly fuel percentage that shifts cost risk onto buyers.
composition: extreme asymmetric composition, off-centre on the right thirds
alt_text: A matte clay parcel block locked against a sliding gauge on a steel rail in a bare warehouse.
caption: USPS Shifts To Fuel Surcharge: Weekly rate resets transfer pricing risk to shippers.
title: USPS Shifts To Fuel Surcharge

review.depicts: A grey block and an orange mechanical device with a dial sit on a metal rail on a concrete floor.
review.reason: The image shows a sliding gauge and block, which serves as a metaphor for a shifting charge.
